basic_details.job_title: IIM Nagpur Library Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Nagpur invites applications for the position of Library Trainee on contract basis, with a consolidated stipend in the range of ₹25,000/- to ₹35,000/- per month for a fixed term of one year (extendable, total tenure not exceeding 2 years). Candidates with a First-class Post Graduation degree in Library and Information Science and age not exceeding 27 years must apply online only on the IIM Nagpur website latest by 17 November 2026 up to 5 PM.

content_sections.heading: IIM Nagpur Library Trainee Quick Facts
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.details: One year, may be extended; total tenure not to exceed 2 years
First-class Post Graduation degree in Library and Information Science from a recognized university

content_sections.heading: About IIM Nagpur
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Nagpur describes itself in the notice as an Institute of National Importance. Its office is at Plot No. 1, Sector 20, MIHAN (Non-SEZ), Nagpur – 441108. The Library Trainee position is meant for people who want a career in library and knowledge management and wish to gain practical experience through close engagement with the library, the faculty and the students of the institute.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: First-class Post Graduation degree in Library and Information Science from a recognized university. A good academic record and a willingness to learn. Experience of working in Higher Education Institutions, Premier B-Schools or Research is desirable. It is not listed as a compulsory requirement. The age of the candidate must be not exceeding 27 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the Library Trainee position.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The exact amount within this range depends on the candidate's qualifications, experience and performance in the interview. The stipend is paid on a consolidated monthly stipend mode. The selected candidate will be offered a fixed term appointment for a period of one year. The contract may be extended further based on the performance and the institute's requirements. The total tenure of the Library Trainee in the institute will not exceed 2 years. A certificate of experience will be issued to those who complete at least six months of the traineeship.

rows.stipend: In the range of ₹25,000/- ₹35,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: IIM Nagpur Library Trainee Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties and responsibilities of the appointee shall include, but not be limited to, the following: Work shift duties 6 days a week, including Sundays and public holidays, as per the needs of the Institute. Conduct circulation, shelving and reference service duties regularly. Catalogue and classify the library books using standard rules (MARC21, DDC etc.). Assist users in locating library books and other information sources. Assist the Assistant Library & Information Officer in day-to-day library operations. Attend any other duties the reporting authorities assign from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Nagpur Library Trainee
content_sections.text: Interested candidates who meet all the job requirements must apply online only on the IIM Nagpur website, through the application link on the Library Trainee page, latest by 17 November 2026 up to 5 PM. The notice does not describe the steps of the online form or list documents to upload.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says the stipend is decided by the candidate's qualifications, experience and performance in the interview, so an interview forms part of the selection. The notice does not give the interview date, the venue or any other stage of selection.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted online only, on the IIM Nagpur website. Only candidates meeting all the job requirements should apply. The position is on contract basis and the total tenure cannot go beyond 2 years. Shift duties include Sundays and public holidays, 6 days a week. Contact given on the page: 0712-287-0315, [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIM Nagpur Library Trainee 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIM Nagpur Library Trainee position is 17 November 2026, up to 5 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for IIM Nagpur Library Trainee?
faq.answer: Candidates need a First-class Post Graduation degree in Library and Information Science from a recognized university, with a good academic record and a willingness to learn.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for IIM Nagpur Library Trainee?
faq.answer: The age of the candidate must be not exceeding 27 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for IIM Nagpur Library Trainee?
faq.answer: The consolidated stipend is in the range of ₹25,000/- to ₹35,000/- per month, depending on the qualifications, experience and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for IIM Nagpur Library Trainee 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only on the IIM Nagpur website, latest by 17 November 2026 up to 5 PM.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an interview for IIM Nagpur Library Trainee?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says the stipend depends partly on the candidate's performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is IIM Nagpur Library Trainee a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract position with a fixed term of one year, which may be extended based on performance and the institute's requirements, up to a total tenure of 2 years.

faq.question: Q8. Will I get an experience certificate as IIM Nagpur Library Trainee?
faq.answer: Yes, a certificate of experience will be issued to those who complete at least six months of the traineeship.

faq.question: Q9. Does the IIM Nagpur Library Trainee have to work on Sundays?
faq.answer: Yes, the selected candidate will work shift duties 6 days a week, including Sundays and public holidays, as per the needs of the Institute.

faq.question: Q10. Is work experience necessary for IIM Nagpur Library Trainee?
faq.answer: No, experience of working in Higher Education Institutions, Premier B-Schools or Research is only desirable.
